about.en: Junior AI Engineer at Fanisin and a Bachelor's degree graduate in Computer Science (S.Kom) from BINUS University.
about.id: Junior AI Engineer di Fanisin dan lulusan Sarjana Ilmu Komputer (S.Kom) dari BINUS University.

about.en: At Fanisin — a US-based startup — I help build an AI character app platform end to end: one cross-platform app with React Native (Expo) and TypeScript, real-time video and voice (WebRTC), secure payments with Stripe, and a serverless backend on AWS (CDK, Lambda, DynamoDB, Bedrock). My work spans feature development, AI integration, testing, debugging and production support — and before that, as a freelance full-stack developer (Apr–May 2026), I built ERP modules with Next.js for a local enterprise.
about.id: Di Fanisin — startup asal Amerika — saya ikut membangun platform aplikasi karakter AI dari ujung ke ujung: satu aplikasi lintas platform dengan React Native (Expo) dan TypeScript, video dan suara real-time (WebRTC), pembayaran aman dengan Stripe, serta backend serverless di AWS (CDK, Lambda, DynamoDB, Bedrock). Pekerjaan saya mencakup pengembangan fitur, integrasi AI, testing, debugging, dan dukungan production — dan sebelumnya, sebagai freelance full-stack developer (Apr–Mei 2026), saya membangun modul ERP dengan Next.js untuk sebuah perusahaan lokal.

about.en: Passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), mobile technologies, and building reliable software that delivers meaningful user experiences. Continuously learning and exploring new technologies to grow as an engineer and create impactful solutions.
about.id: Antusias dengan Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLM), teknologi mobile, dan membangun software andal yang memberi pengalaman bermakna bagi pengguna. Terus belajar dan mengeksplorasi teknologi baru untuk berkembang sebagai engineer dan menciptakan solusi yang berdampak.

description.en: The main Fanisin app: fans text, voice-call and video-call the AI twins of creators and experts they trust. I build new features and the main front end, polish the UI across pages, debug production issues and create banner visuals — with Claude Code, Claude Design, APIs and webhooks.
description.id: Aplikasi utama Fanisin: penggemar bisa chat, telepon, dan video call dengan AI twin kreator dan pakar yang mereka percaya. Saya membangun fitur baru dan front end utama, merapikan UI di berbagai halaman, men-debug masalah production, dan membuat visual banner — dengan Claude Code, Claude Design, API, dan webhook.

story.en: Fanisin is the parent app of a growing roster of creators who have become AI twins. Fans can chat, call, or video-call a twin built from material the creator approves — any time of day, on iOS, Android and the web.
story.id: Fanisin adalah aplikasi induk bagi deretan kreator yang terus bertambah dan kini punya AI twin. Penggemar bisa chat, telepon, atau video call dengan twin yang dibangun dari materi yang disetujui sang kreator — kapan saja, di iOS, Android, dan web.

story.en: As an engineer on the full-stack and mobile side, I work across the product: shipping new features end to end, building the main front end — the home page, hero and creator catalog — and optimising how every other page looks and feels on mobile and desktop. Under the hood that means a serverless AWS backend, real-time AI video and voice, and a Stripe-powered token economy.
story.id: Sebagai engineer di sisi full-stack dan mobile, saya bekerja di seluruh produk: merilis fitur baru dari awal sampai akhir, membangun front end utama — beranda, hero, dan katalog kreator — serta mengoptimalkan tampilan dan nuansa setiap halaman lain di mobile dan desktop. Di balik layar, itu berarti backend serverless di AWS, video dan suara AI real-time, serta ekonomi token berbasis Stripe.

story.en: Day to day that means debugging real production issues, wiring features to APIs and webhooks, and even creating content like banners for launches. I build with AI tooling — Claude Code for engineering and Claude Design for visuals — to move from idea to production fast.
story.id: Sehari-hari itu berarti men-debug masalah production yang nyata, menghubungkan fitur ke API dan webhook, bahkan membuat konten seperti banner untuk peluncuran. Saya membangun dengan bantuan AI — Claude Code untuk engineering dan Claude Design untuk visual — supaya ide cepat sampai ke production.

description.en: A single-character app built on the Fanisin platform: a calm space to talk with Jesus by video, voice or text — to ask about faith and scripture, or simply reflect.
description.id: Aplikasi satu karakter di atas platform Fanisin: ruang yang tenang untuk berbicara dengan Yesus lewat video, suara, atau teks — untuk bertanya tentang iman dan Alkitab, atau sekadar merenung.

story.en: Jesus Live takes Fanisin's AI-twin technology and focuses it on one character. The whole experience is designed to feel calm and warm — a place to talk, ask about faith and scripture, or simply sit and reflect.
story.id: Jesus Live membawa teknologi AI twin Fanisin dan memfokuskannya pada satu karakter. Seluruh pengalamannya dirancang agar terasa tenang dan hangat — tempat untuk berbicara, bertanya tentang iman dan Alkitab, atau sekadar duduk dan merenung.

story.en: I built the mobile front end around that feeling: a soft cream-and-gold design, a gentle home screen, and a simple flow to choose how you want to talk.
story.id: Saya membangun front end mobile-nya dengan nuansa itu: desain krem dan emas yang lembut, layar beranda yang teduh, dan alur sederhana untuk memilih cara kamu ingin berbicara.

title.en: Fly Calmer — Talk with Pilot Pete
title.id: Fly Calmer — Ngobrol dengan Pilot Pete

description.en: A single-character app on the Fanisin platform for anxious flyers: a pilot in your pocket. Talk with Pilot Pete through turbulence, take-off and landing — by video, voice or text.
description.id: Aplikasi satu karakter di platform Fanisin untuk penumpang yang takut terbang: pilot di saku kamu. Ngobrol dengan Pilot Pete saat turbulensi, lepas landas, dan mendarat — lewat video, suara, atau teks.

story.en: Fly Calmer brings the Fanisin AI-twin experience to one very specific moment: being scared on a plane. Pilot Pete — a real airline pilot who founded Fly Calmer — becomes a companion you can talk to before and during your flight.
story.id: Fly Calmer membawa pengalaman AI twin Fanisin ke satu momen yang sangat spesifik: rasa takut di pesawat. Pilot Pete — pilot maskapai sungguhan yang mendirikan Fly Calmer — menjadi teman bicara sebelum dan selama penerbangan.

story.en: I worked on the web front end: a calm navy aviation look, quick topics for the moments that scare people most, and a clear tokens and billing page.
story.id: Saya mengerjakan front end web-nya: tampilan penerbangan bernuansa navy yang tenang, topik cepat untuk momen yang paling menakutkan, serta halaman token dan tagihan yang jelas.

description.en: Initiated the front-end development for a payment management application. Built a modular and reusable architecture using components like modals and forms to handle payment modules and fund requests. The development prioritized user interactivity and strict adherence to UI/UX design specifications for a seamless payment experience.
description.id: Memulai pengembangan front end untuk aplikasi manajemen pembayaran. Membangun arsitektur modular dan reusable dengan komponen seperti modal dan form untuk menangani modul pembayaran dan pengajuan dana. Pengembangannya mengutamakan interaktivitas pengguna dan kepatuhan ketat pada spesifikasi desain UI/UX demi pengalaman pembayaran yang mulus.

description.en: Focused on the development of a digital recruitment platform. Using React Native, I translated complex Figma designs into precise code for a multi-step registration process. This included meticulous UI slicing to ensure 100% design accuracy and seamless integration with backend APIs to handle user registration data effectively.
description.id: Berfokus pada pengembangan platform rekrutmen digital. Dengan React Native, saya menerjemahkan desain Figma yang kompleks menjadi kode yang presisi untuk proses registrasi multi-langkah. Termasuk slicing UI yang teliti agar desain 100% akurat, serta integrasi mulus dengan API backend untuk mengelola data registrasi pengguna.

description.en: Developed a comprehensive logistics management ecosystem consisting of a web dashboard and a mobile application. The web component features analytical dashboards and data management for users and locations. The mobile app, developed using pure Java, includes core features such as QR Code scanning logic, data validation history, and authentication modules, focusing on real-time data synchronization between platforms.
description.id: Mengembangkan ekosistem manajemen logistik yang lengkap, terdiri dari dashboard web dan aplikasi mobile. Bagian web memiliki dashboard analitik serta manajemen data pengguna dan lokasi. Aplikasi mobile-nya, dibangun dengan Java murni, mencakup fitur inti seperti logika pemindaian QR Code, riwayat validasi data, dan modul autentikasi, dengan fokus pada sinkronisasi data real-time antarplatform.

description.en: Successfully redeveloped the internal Human Resource Information System (HRIS) website using the PHP CodeIgniter 4 framework. The project involved creating a comprehensive dashboard, managing employee attendance, profiles, and labor data. I implemented a dynamic organizational structure visualization and a system-wide Dark Mode using advanced JavaScript logic. Security measures included middleware implementation, Captcha verification, and API integration for authentication and verification processes.
description.id: Berhasil membangun ulang website Human Resource Information System (HRIS) internal dengan framework PHP CodeIgniter 4. Proyek ini mencakup pembuatan dashboard lengkap serta pengelolaan absensi, profil, dan data ketenagakerjaan karyawan. Saya mengimplementasikan visualisasi struktur organisasi yang dinamis dan Dark Mode di seluruh sistem dengan logika JavaScript tingkat lanjut. Dari sisi keamanan, saya menerapkan middleware, verifikasi Captcha, dan integrasi API untuk proses autentikasi dan verifikasi.

description.en: Head of the event division for Kemanggisan Sportfest, the annual campus sports tournament.
description.id: Menjabat sebagai kepala divisi acara untuk turnamen olahraga tahunan Kemanggisan Sportfest.

story.en: As the Head of Event Division for Kemanggisan Sportfest 2024, I was responsible for planning, organizing, and executing all event activities during this major campus sports festival. I led a team of dedicated committee members to ensure that multiple sports competitions and activities ran smoothly throughout the event.
story.id: Sebagai Kepala Divisi Acara Kemanggisan Sportfest 2024, saya bertanggung jawab merencanakan, mengorganisir, dan menjalankan seluruh kegiatan acara selama festival olahraga kampus besar ini. Saya memimpin tim panitia yang berdedikasi agar berbagai kompetisi dan kegiatan olahraga berjalan lancar sepanjang acara.

story.en: The Sportfest brought together students from various departments and programs to compete in basketball, volleyball, futsal, badminton, and other sports. My division was tasked with coordinating schedules, managing venues, overseeing referees, and ensuring all participants had a positive experience throughout the competition.
story.id: Sportfest mempertemukan mahasiswa dari berbagai jurusan dan program untuk bertanding basket, voli, futsal, bulu tangkis, dan cabang olahraga lainnya. Divisi saya bertugas mengoordinasikan jadwal, mengelola venue, mengawasi wasit, dan memastikan semua peserta mendapat pengalaman yang menyenangkan selama kompetisi.

description.id: Memimpin unit kegiatan mahasiswa Binusian Gaming region Kemanggisan, mengelola tim, dan menyusun strategi pengembangan komunitas gaming kampus.

story.en: As the Chairperson of the Kemanggisan Region for Binusian Gaming, I was responsible for managing the student activity unit's operations and events on campus. I led strategic initiatives to develop esports culture within the university while creating opportunities for students to enhance their gaming skills and build community.
story.id: Sebagai Ketua Binusian Gaming Region Kemanggisan, saya bertanggung jawab mengelola operasional dan acara unit kegiatan mahasiswa ini di kampus. Saya memimpin inisiatif strategis untuk mengembangkan budaya esports di universitas sekaligus membuka kesempatan bagi mahasiswa untuk mengasah skill gaming dan membangun komunitas.

story.en: During my leadership, I coordinated major competitions, including the Arena Community Championship 2024 in collaboration with Gopay, and served as the Person-In-Charge for the Binusian Gaming Level Up! Esport Championship season 1. These events significantly increased our organization's visibility and helped establish meaningful partnerships with industry stakeholders.
story.id: Selama kepemimpinan saya, saya mengoordinasikan kompetisi besar, termasuk Arena Community Championship 2024 bersama Gopay, dan menjadi Person-In-Charge untuk Binusian Gaming Level Up! Esport Championship season 1. Acara-acara ini meningkatkan visibilitas organisasi secara signifikan dan membuka kemitraan yang berarti dengan para pelaku industri.

story.en: As the Chairperson of Binusian Gaming for the Kemanggisan Region, I led our esports organization through a transformative year focused on community building, competitive excellence, and industry partnerships. Binusian Gaming serves as the premier student activity unit dedicated to developing gaming culture and esports at BINUS University.
story.id: Sebagai Ketua Binusian Gaming Region Kemanggisan, saya memimpin organisasi esports kami melewati tahun penuh transformasi yang berfokus pada membangun komunitas, prestasi kompetitif, dan kemitraan industri. Binusian Gaming adalah unit kegiatan mahasiswa utama yang mengembangkan budaya gaming dan esports di BINUS University.

story.en: During my tenure, I implemented strategic initiatives to enhance member engagement, create professional development opportunities, and establish Binusian Gaming as a recognized entity in the collegiate esports landscape. Our efforts resulted in successful national-level competitions, industry collaborations, and a stronger internal community.
story.id: Selama masa jabatan saya, saya menjalankan inisiatif strategis untuk meningkatkan keterlibatan anggota, membuka peluang pengembangan profesional, dan menjadikan Binusian Gaming entitas yang diakui di kancah esports kampus. Hasilnya: kompetisi tingkat nasional yang sukses, kolaborasi dengan industri, dan komunitas internal yang semakin solid.

highlights.id: Menambah keanggotaan organisasi sebesar 40% lewat kampanye rekrutmen yang terarah

story.en: As the Person-In-Charge (PIC) for the inaugural season of Binusian Gaming Level Up! Esport Championship, I led a cross-functional team to create an engaging competitive platform for student gamers. This event featured multiple game titles including Mobile Legends, Valorant, and FIFA, attracting participants from across all BINUS campuses.
story.id: Sebagai Person-In-Charge (PIC) musim perdana Binusian Gaming Level Up! Esport Championship, saya memimpin tim lintas fungsi untuk menciptakan panggung kompetisi yang seru bagi gamer mahasiswa. Acara ini mempertandingkan beberapa judul game seperti Mobile Legends, Valorant, dan FIFA, dan menarik peserta dari seluruh kampus BINUS.

story.en: The championship was designed to discover and nurture gaming talent within the university while promoting healthy competition and skill development. Throughout the multi-week tournament, we organized livestreamed matches, player spotlights, and professional commentary to elevate the experience.
story.id: Kejuaraan ini dirancang untuk menemukan dan membina talenta gaming di kampus sambil mendorong kompetisi yang sehat dan pengembangan skill. Sepanjang turnamen yang berlangsung beberapa minggu, kami menghadirkan pertandingan live streaming, sorotan pemain, dan komentator profesional untuk meningkatkan pengalamannya.

story.en: The Gopay Arena Community Championship (GACC) was a national-level esports competition organized in partnership with GoPay. As the National Competition Committee Lead, I coordinated with multiple stakeholders to deliver a premier esports experience for collegiate and community gamers across Indonesia.
story.id: Gopay Arena Community Championship (GACC) adalah kompetisi esports tingkat nasional yang diselenggarakan bersama GoPay. Sebagai Ketua Panitia Kompetisi Nasional, saya berkoordinasi dengan banyak pihak untuk menghadirkan pengalaman esports kelas atas bagi gamer kampus dan komunitas di seluruh Indonesia.

story.en: This championship offered a significant prize pool and provided an opportunity for BINUS students to compete against teams from other universities and gaming communities. The event generated substantial visibility for Binusian Gaming and established our reputation as a serious contributor to the collegiate esports scene.
story.id: Kejuaraan ini menawarkan total hadiah yang besar dan memberi kesempatan mahasiswa BINUS bertanding melawan tim dari universitas dan komunitas gaming lain. Acara ini mendongkrak visibilitas Binusian Gaming dan mengukuhkan reputasi kami sebagai kontributor serius di kancah esports kampus.

story.en: Teach For Indonesia and the BINUS University School of Accounting, together with the West Jakarta Office of Industry, Trade, Cooperatives and SMEs (PPKUKM), held an indoor bazaar themed "Produk Lokal Berkreasi Generasi Muda Berkarya" (Creative Local Products, Young Generation at Work). Held on 29–30 October 2024 at BINUS @Kemanggisan, Anggrek Campus, it featured 20 small businesses mentored by the West Jakarta PPKUKM office from 8 districts.
story.id: Teach For Indonesia bersama dengan School of Accounting BINUS University berkolaborasi dengan Suku Dinas Perindustrian, Perdagangan, Koperasi, Usaha Kecil dan Menengah (PPKUKM) Jakarta Barat menggelar bazar indoor dengan tema "Produk Lokal Berkreasi Generasi Muda Berkarya". Acara yang diselenggarakan pada tanggal 29 & 30 Oktober 2024 di BINUS @Kemanggisan, Kampus Anggrek ini menampilkan 20 pelaku UMKM binaan Sudis PPKUKM Jakarta Barat dari 8 wilayah kecamatan.

story.en: As part of the event, I helped run a "Mobile Legend" esports competition that drew 31 high-school and vocational-school teams from across West Jakarta. The winners received a BINUS University scholarship, cash and shopping vouchers worth Rp 1.5 million. Beyond the esports competition, the event also featured workshops such as batik making, paper craft and resin keychain making.
story.id: Sebagai bagian dari kegiatan ini, saya terlibat dalam penyelenggaraan Lomba E-Sport "Mobile Legend" yang berhasil menarik partisipasi 31 tim tingkat SMA dan SMK se-Jakarta Barat. Pemenang pertama berkesempatan mendapatkan hadiah berupa beasiswa dari BINUS University, uang tunai dan voucher belanja senilai Rp 1,5 juta. Selain kompetisi esports, acara juga dimeriahkan dengan berbagai workshop seperti membatik, Paper Craft, dan pembuatan Gantungan Kunci Resin.

story.en: The event was attended by Mr. Iqbal Idham Ramid, Head of the West Jakarta PPKUKM Office; Mr. Febri, Head of the Economic Affairs Division of the West Jakarta City Secretariat; and Mrs. Reina S.Kom., M.M, Vice Rector of Academic Operation and Resources.

story.en: To strengthen BINUS University's place in Indonesia's esports ecosystem, I helped build a strategic partnership between Binusian Gaming and Mineski, one of Southeast Asia's leading esports organizations. The collaboration was a breakthrough for the campus esports community through its participation in World Cyber Games (WCG) Indonesia 2024.
story.id: Sebagai bagian dari upaya memperkuat posisi BINUS University dalam ekosistem esports Indonesia, saya terlibat dalam menjalin kerjasama strategis antara Binusian Gaming dan Mineski, organisasi esports ternama di Asia Tenggara. Kolaborasi ini menjadi gebrakan baru dalam komunitas esports kampus melalui partisipasi dalam acara World Cyber Games (WCG) Indonesia 2024.

story.en: As a result of the negotiations, Mineski provided 80 free two-day passes for Binusian Gaming members, BINUS students and partner esports communities. The initiative was designed to get young people involved in Indonesia's fast-growing esports industry.
story.id: Hasil dari negosiasi yang dilakukan, Mineski memberikan dukungan berupa 80 tiket masuk gratis untuk dua hari pelaksanaan acara bagi anggota Binusian Gaming, mahasiswa BINUS, dan komunitas esports terkait. Inisiatif ini dirancang untuk mendorong keterlibatan generasi muda dalam industri esports yang berkembang pesat di Indonesia.

story.en: On Friday, 7 February 2025, I helped organize Honor of Kings Campus Attack at BINUS Kemanggisan. Held at the Anggrek Campus from 1 to 5 PM, the tournament became a prestigious event that brought Binusians from different regions together in an exciting, challenging gaming competition.
story.id: Pada Jumat, 7 Februari 2025, saya terlibat dalam penyelenggaraan Honor of Kings Campus Attack di BINUS Kemanggisan. Turnamen yang berlangsung di Kampus Anggrek dari pukul 13.00 hingga 17.00 WIB ini berhasil menjadi ajang prestisius yang menyatukan para binusian dari berbagai region dalam kompetisi gaming yang seru dan menantang.

story.en: As event coordinator, I made sure the tournament was not only a competition but also a way to bring students closer together. It gave the winning team a golden opportunity to represent BINUS University in the next round.
story.id: Sebagai koordinator acara, saya memastikan bahwa turnamen ini tidak hanya menjadi arena kompetisi, tetapi juga wadah untuk mempererat solidaritas antar mahasiswa. Acara ini menawarkan kesempatan emas bagi tim pemenang untuk mewakili BINUS University di babak selanjutnya.

story.en: As part of my initiative to promote esports culture within the university, I took an active role in supporting and coordinating esports activities during BINUS Festival (BIFEST) 2024. In collaboration with Binusian Gaming, we successfully organized a two-day esports tournament that attracted passionate gamers from various faculties.
story.id: Sebagai bagian dari inisiatif saya memajukan budaya esports di kampus, saya aktif mendukung dan mengoordinasikan kegiatan esports di BINUS Festival (BIFEST) 2024. Bersama Binusian Gaming, kami sukses menggelar turnamen esports dua hari yang menarik gamer antusias dari berbagai fakultas.

story.en: On the first day, participants competed in a high-energy Valorant tournament, where strategic teamwork and precision were on full display. The second day shifted focus to the mobile gaming scene with an intense Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) competition, showcasing fast-paced action and team synergy.
story.id: Di hari pertama, peserta beradu di turnamen Valorant yang penuh energi, memamerkan kerja sama tim yang strategis dan presisi. Hari kedua beralih ke mobile gaming lewat kompetisi Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) yang sengit, penuh aksi cepat dan sinergi tim.

story.en: This event went beyond mere competition; it served as a platform to foster community building, expand the gaming network within the campus, and cultivate a fun yet professional esports environment.
story.id: Acara ini lebih dari sekadar kompetisi; ia menjadi wadah untuk membangun komunitas, memperluas jaringan gaming di kampus, dan menumbuhkan lingkungan esports yang seru namun tetap profesional.

story.en: An important focus of my leadership has been establishing collaborative relationships with other BINUS campuses and student organizations. These cross-campus initiatives have helped unify the Binusian Gaming community across all university locations and created synergies with complementary student groups.
story.id: Salah satu fokus penting kepemimpinan saya adalah menjalin kolaborasi dengan kampus BINUS lain dan organisasi mahasiswa. Inisiatif lintas kampus ini menyatukan komunitas Binusian Gaming di semua lokasi kampus dan menciptakan sinergi dengan kelompok mahasiswa yang saling melengkapi.

story.en: One notable event was the Binusian Gaming Campus Collaboration held at Kemanggisan on November 29, 2024. This initiative brought together Binusian Gaming, Universitas Indonesia ESports Club (UIESC), and Veteran Jakarta E-Sports (VJE) under the theme "From Sharing to Shaping the Next Generation."
story.id: Salah satu acara yang menonjol adalah Binusian Gaming Campus Collaboration di Kemanggisan pada 29 November 2024. Inisiatif ini mempertemukan Binusian Gaming, Universitas Indonesia ESports Club (UIESC), dan Veteran Jakarta E-Sports (VJE) dengan tema "From Sharing to Shaping the Next Generation."

story.en: The event began with a Benchmarking Session, followed by a Group Discussion Session titled "Listen and Improve", and closed with a Campus Tour at BINUS University’s Anggrek campus.
story.id: Acara dibuka dengan Sesi Benchmarking, dilanjutkan Sesi Diskusi Kelompok bertajuk "Listen and Improve", dan ditutup dengan Campus Tour di kampus Anggrek BINUS University.

description.id: Menjadi pendamping bagi calon mahasiswa baru Binusian 2027 untuk proses adaptasi lingkungan kampus dan akademik.

story.en: Advanced Buddy is a collaborative program between the Student Development Center and Marketing Unit of BINUS @Malang designed to introduce prospective students to university life at BINUS while establishing a communication bridge between BINUS @Malang campus and future students.
story.id: Advanced Buddy adalah program kolaborasi Student Development Center dan Unit Marketing BINUS @Malang untuk mengenalkan calon mahasiswa pada kehidupan kuliah di BINUS sekaligus membangun jembatan komunikasi antara kampus BINUS @Malang dan calon mahasiswanya.

story.en: This three-month program (February 2023 to May 2023) encompassed a variety of activities, including campus introductions, "What You Wanna Be" sharing sessions, introductions to each department’s academic systems, and a final project featuring creative videos on Instagram and TikTok about "Why You Choose BINUS @Malang."
story.id: Program tiga bulan ini (Februari 2023 hingga Mei 2023) mencakup beragam kegiatan, mulai dari pengenalan kampus, sesi sharing "What You Wanna Be", pengenalan sistem akademik tiap jurusan, hingga proyek akhir berupa video kreatif di Instagram dan TikTok tentang "Why You Choose BINUS @Malang."

story.en: As an Advanced Buddy, I had the opportunity to mentor prospective Binusian 2027 students, guiding them through their transition from high school to university life, answering their questions about majors and campus life, and helping them build connections within the BINUS community before they officially enrolled.
story.id: Sebagai Advanced Buddy, saya berkesempatan membimbing calon mahasiswa Binusian 2027 dalam masa transisi dari SMA ke dunia kuliah, menjawab pertanyaan mereka seputar jurusan dan kehidupan kampus, serta membantu mereka membangun relasi di komunitas BINUS sebelum resmi mendaftar.

description.en: Responsible for smooth technical and multimedia operations throughout a series of academic seminars at Binus Malang.
description.id: Bertanggung jawab atas kelancaran teknis dan multimedia selama rangkaian seminar akademik di Binus Malang.

story.en: As a member of the Binus Malang Seminar Committee, I was responsible for providing technical and multimedia support for a major academic seminar hosted by our campus. The seminar brought together industry professionals, academics, and students to discuss emerging trends in technology and business.
story.id: Sebagai anggota Panitia Seminar Binus Malang, saya bertanggung jawab atas dukungan teknis dan multimedia untuk seminar akademik besar yang diselenggarakan kampus kami. Seminar ini mempertemukan praktisi industri, akademisi, dan mahasiswa untuk membahas tren terbaru di bidang teknologi dan bisnis.

story.en: Working closely with a dedicated team, I helped ensure the seamless execution of the event by managing audiovisual equipment, supporting presenters with their technical needs, and documenting the event through photography and video. This experience enhanced my event management skills while allowing me to contribute to an important educational initiative at our university.
story.id: Bekerja erat dengan tim yang berdedikasi, saya membantu memastikan acara berjalan mulus dengan mengelola peralatan audiovisual, membantu kebutuhan teknis para pembicara, serta mendokumentasikan acara lewat foto dan video. Pengalaman ini mengasah kemampuan manajemen acara saya sekaligus memberi kesempatan berkontribusi pada inisiatif pendidikan penting di kampus.

description.en: An app that helps people with disabilities and the general public learn Indonesian Sign Language (BISINDO).
description.id: Aplikasi mobile untuk membantu pembelajaran Bahasa Isyarat Indonesia (BISINDO) bagi penyandang disabilitas dan masyarakat umum.

story.en: CerdasAps Bahasa Isyarat is a comprehensive web-based sign language learning application designed to bridge communication gaps between hearing and deaf communities. The platform features an extensive library of sign language videos and photos that enable interactive learning experiences.
story.id: CerdasAps Bahasa Isyarat adalah aplikasi belajar bahasa isyarat berbasis web yang lengkap, dirancang untuk menjembatani komunikasi antara komunitas dengar dan Tuli. Platform ini memiliki koleksi video dan foto bahasa isyarat yang luas untuk pengalaman belajar yang interaktif.

story.en: The application provides step-by-step tutorials through high-quality videos demonstrating proper hand movements and expressions for various words and phrases. Users can track their progress, practice with interactive exercises, and receive feedback on their signing techniques through the integrated learning system.
story.id: Aplikasi ini menyediakan tutorial langkah demi langkah lewat video berkualitas tinggi yang memperagakan gerakan tangan dan ekspresi yang tepat untuk berbagai kata dan frasa. Pengguna bisa memantau progres, berlatih dengan latihan interaktif, dan mendapat masukan atas teknik isyarat mereka melalui sistem pembelajaran terintegrasi.

story.en: Key features include categorized learning modules, search functionality for specific signs, slow-motion video playback for detailed movement study, and a community forum for users to share experiences and ask questions.
story.id: Fitur utamanya meliputi modul belajar berdasarkan kategori, pencarian isyarat tertentu, pemutaran video slow-motion untuk mempelajari gerakan secara detail, dan forum komunitas untuk berbagi pengalaman dan bertanya.

description.en: An Augmented Reality (AR) learning app that brings classroom material to life interactively, built with Unity and Assemblr.
description.id: Aplikasi pembelajaran berbasis Augmented Reality (AR) untuk membantu visualisasi materi kelas secara interaktif menggunakan teknologi Unity dan Assemblr.

story.en: Digital Class is an innovative Android application that leverages augmented reality (AR) technology to enhance the learning experience in educational settings. The app allows educators to create interactive 3D models and AR experiences that students can explore through their mobile devices, making complex concepts more engaging and easier to understand.
story.id: Digital Class adalah aplikasi Android inovatif yang memanfaatkan teknologi augmented reality (AR) untuk meningkatkan pengalaman belajar. Aplikasi ini memungkinkan pengajar membuat model 3D dan pengalaman AR interaktif yang bisa dijelajahi siswa lewat perangkat mobile, sehingga konsep yang rumit jadi lebih menarik dan mudah dipahami.

story.en: Using Unity and Assemblr EDU integration, Digital Class provides educators with tools to develop custom AR content specific to their curriculum. The application features user authentication, content management, real-time collaboration, and progress tracking to create a comprehensive digital learning environment.
story.id: Dengan integrasi Unity dan Assemblr EDU, Digital Class memberi pengajar alat untuk membuat konten AR sesuai kurikulum mereka. Aplikasi ini dilengkapi autentikasi pengguna, manajemen konten, kolaborasi real-time, dan pelacakan progres untuk menciptakan lingkungan belajar digital yang lengkap.

highlights.id: Model 3D interaktif dengan fitur AR untuk visualisasi yang lebih baik

highlights.id: Alat pembuatan konten bagi pengajar untuk menyusun materi belajar

description.en: OBENG (Online Bengkel) is a comprehensive web platform that connects vehicle owners with auto repair shops through an online service booking system.
description.id: OBENG (Online Bengkel) adalah platform web komprehensif yang dirancang untuk menghubungkan pemilik kendaraan dengan bengkel otomotif melalui sistem pemesanan layanan daring.

story.en: OBENG (Online Bengkel) is a comprehensive web platform designed to connect vehicle owners with automotive repair shops. This project addresses the challenge of finding reliable automotive services by creating a streamlined booking system and service marketplace.
story.id: OBENG (Online Bengkel) adalah platform web lengkap yang menghubungkan pemilik kendaraan dengan bengkel otomotif. Proyek ini menjawab sulitnya mencari layanan otomotif yang terpercaya lewat sistem pemesanan yang ringkas dan marketplace layanan.

story.en: The platform features user authentication, service booking, repair shop profiles, service listings, and payment integration. The responsive design ensures accessibility across devices, making vehicle maintenance more convenient for all users.
story.id: Platform ini memiliki autentikasi pengguna, pemesanan layanan, profil bengkel, daftar layanan, dan integrasi pembayaran. Desain responsifnya memastikan akses di semua perangkat, sehingga perawatan kendaraan jadi lebih praktis bagi semua pengguna.

story.id: hero

beats.en: [softly] Ever since junior high, Doddy Suryadharma has carried one dream... [pause] to build worlds. To become a game maker — someone who creates places people can step into, and truly feel.
beats.id: [softly] Dari zaman SMP, Doddy Suryadharma cuma punya satu mimpi... [pause] bikin dunia sendiri. Jadi game maker — orang yang menciptakan tempat buat dijelajahi, dan bikin orang benar-benar ngerasain sesuatu.

beats.en: [warmly] This portfolio is the very first step of that dream. Not a page to read... but a small world to journey through. [excited] So — welcome, traveler. Your adventure begins now.
beats.id: [warmly] Nah, portfolio ini adalah langkah pertamanya. Bukan cuma halaman buat dibaca... tapi dunia kecil buat kamu jelajahi. [excited] Jadi — selamat datang! Yuk, kita mulai petualangannya.

story.id: about

beats.en: [curious] Our first stop... the Adventurer's Camp. [warmly] This is where Doddy's story begins — a Computer Science graduate from BINUS University, who never really stopped building.
beats.id: [curious] Perhentian pertama kita... Markas Sang Petualang. [warmly] Di sinilah cerita Doddy dimulai — lulusan Ilmu Komputer BINUS University, yang nggak pernah berhenti bikin sesuatu.

beats.en: [proudly] Today, he's a Junior AI Engineer at Fanisin — teaching apps to see, to listen, and to talk back. From Jakarta... to people all over the world.
beats.id: [proudly] Sekarang, dia jadi Junior AI Engineer di Fanisin — bikin aplikasi yang bisa lihat, dengar, bahkan ngobrol balik. Dari Jakarta... buat orang-orang di seluruh dunia.

story.id: skills

beats.en: [in awe] Look up. These are the Training Grounds — and every obelisk rises exactly as high as the skill it guards.
beats.id: [in awe] Coba lihat ke atas. Ini Arena Latihan — setiap obelisk makin tinggi, kalau skill-nya makin jago.

beats.en: TypeScript. React and Next.js. Java. Git. [excited] The tallest stones of all — sharpened on real products, long nights... and a truly heroic amount of debugging.
beats.id: TypeScript. React dan Next.js. Java. Git. [excited] Ini yang paling tinggi — diasah lewat produk beneran, begadang berkali-kali... dan debugging yang nggak ada habisnya.

beats.en: [warmly] But his real strength? It's the way he works with people — calm under pressure, and always ready to lead.
beats.id: [warmly] Tapi kekuatan utamanya? Cara dia kerja bareng orang — tetap tenang walaupun di bawah tekanan, dan selalu siap jadi pemimpin.

story.id: portfolio

beats.en: [mysteriously] Beyond the ridge lie the Guild Isles... four islands, and seventeen quests.
beats.id: [mysteriously] Di balik bukit sana, ada Kepulauan Guild... empat pulau, tujuh belas misi.

beats.en: [proudly] The newest isle is where he works today — Fanisin, where fans talk face to face with the AI twins of the creators they love. Then, one character at a time: Jesus Live... and Fly Calmer.
beats.id: [proudly] Pulau terbaru adalah tempat dia kerja sekarang — Fanisin, tempat fans bisa ngobrol langsung sama AI twin creator favoritnya. Lalu, satu karakter demi satu karakter: Jesus Live... dan Fly Calmer.

beats.en: The next isle holds his internships — real systems, for real teams. An HR platform, a payment gateway, a supply system.
beats.id: Pulau berikutnya isinya pengalaman intern — sistem beneran, buat tim beneran. Ada platform HR, payment gateway, sampai sistem supply.

beats.en: [playfully] Another isle is where it all began — campus projects, like a classroom you can walk through in augmented reality.
beats.id: [playfully] Satu pulau lagi, tempat semuanya dimulai — project kampus, kayak ruang kelas yang bisa kamu jelajahi pakai augmented reality.

beats.en: [proudly] And the last... leadership. Guiding the Binusian Gaming community, and running events for hundreds of students.
beats.id: [proudly] Dan yang terakhir... kepemimpinan. Mimpin komunitas Binusian Gaming, sampai bikin acara buat ratusan mahasiswa.

story.id: certifications

beats.en: [hushed] Now... step quietly into the Relic Vault. Every glowing frame is a certificate — machine learning, SQL, mentoring, competitions. [softly] Proof of every lesson learned along the way.
beats.id: [hushed] Sekarang... pelan-pelan, kita masuk ke Ruang Relik. Tiap bingkai yang bersinar itu sertifikat — dari machine learning, SQL, mentoring, sampai kompetisi. [softly] Bukti dari semua yang dia pelajari sepanjang perjalanan.

story.id: resume

beats.en: [reflective] And this... is the Long Road. Every lantern marks a step — a mobile developer internship at PT Siaga Abdi Utama, full-stack contracts... and now, AI engineering at Fanisin.
beats.id: [reflective] Dan ini... Jalan Panjang. Tiap lentera itu satu langkah — jadi intern mobile developer di PT Siaga Abdi Utama, lanjut kontrak full-stack... sampai sekarang, jadi AI engineer di Fanisin.

beats.en: Behind it all, a degree in Computer Science...
beats.id: Semuanya berawal dari kuliah Ilmu Komputer...

beats.en: [warmly] ...and years of leading people — from esports tournaments, to welcoming brand-new students.
beats.id: [warmly] ...dan bertahun-tahun jadi pemimpin — dari turnamen esports, sampai nyambut mahasiswa baru.

story.id: contact

beats.en: [softly] And so we reach the Beacon — the end of the first chapter of his dream... [pause] [warmly] and maybe, the beginning of your story with him.
beats.id: [softly] Dan akhirnya, kita sampai di Mercusuar — akhir dari bab pertama mimpinya... [pause] [warmly] dan mungkin, awal dari ceritamu bareng dia.

beats.en: [excited] Light the beacon to send him a message... or ask his Oracle anything at all. [whispers] One day, these isles will become a real game. [warmly] Thank you for playing the very first level.
beats.id: [excited] Nyalakan mercusuarnya buat kirim pesan... atau tanya apa aja ke Oracle-nya. [whispers] Suatu hari nanti, pulau-pulau ini bakal jadi game beneran. [warmly] Makasih ya, udah mainin level pertamanya.

description_items: Cross-Platform Architecture: Architected a unified Expo and React Native application for Web, iOS, and Android, implementing TypeScript and Expo Router to deliver seamless real-time video, voice, and text synchronization.

Real-Time AI & Media: Integrated Tavus conversational AI, ElevenLabs voice agents, and Daily.co WebRTC, optimizing manual track subscriptions and exit-hook cleanups to eliminate cold-start freezes and resource leaks.

Serverless Backend: Engineered a scalable infrastructure using 25+ AWS Lambda functions and DynamoDB with Global Secondary Indexes (GSI), featuring a FIFO token ledger and an atomic-safe chat quota system.

Secure Payments & Auth: Implemented Clerk JWT-based RBAC and a robust Stripe subscription engine with idempotent webhook processing and DynamoDB ConditionExpressions for refund-safe ledger management.
Advanced AI Memory: Built a sophisticated LLM pipeline using AWS Bedrock (Claude) to extract durable user facts from transcripts, enabling multi-session context injection without persona mutation.
DevOps & IaC: Orchestrated multi-environment AWS CDK v2 stacks for automated cross-account deployments, incorporating CodePipeline, Route 53 delegation, and branch-based manual approval gates.
Full-Stack Web: Built core ERP master data modules (Customer, Supplier, CoA) using Next.js 16, React 19, and Prisma 7, implementing full CRUD flows, Zod validation, and Role-Based Access Control.
Authentication & Security: Implemented a secure NextAuth v5 flow featuring OTP verification, multi-company selection, and middleware-based route protection with JWT and bcrypt hashing.
Data Export & Reporting: Developed high-performance CSV export tools and integrated Puppeteer for server-side PDF generation to automate operational and financial reporting.
Testing & Quality: Engineered unit tests using Vitest for API handlers and services, significantly increasing code reliability and mitigating regression risks during development iterations.
UI/UX Implementation: Translated complex Figma designs into responsive interfaces using Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui, featuring dynamic data tables and advanced multi-step forms.
DevOps & Logging: Streamlined development and debugging by containerizing PostgreSQL environments with Docker Compose and implementing structured logging with Winston.

Mobile Development: Developed Version 2 of an internal Mobile HRIS application to support employee attendance, overtime and leave requests, and upcoming task management, integrating GPS, camera, and local storage to enhance operational efficiency.
Full-Stack Web: Developed responsive applications with Next.js, React, and PHP, ensuring seamless API and database integration.
UI/UX Implementation: Converted complex Figma designs into pixel-perfect, functional code while maintaining cross-platform consistency.
Optimization: Built dynamic, high-performance interfaces and multi-step forms to improve data flow and user efficiency.
Led the regional student activity unit, overseeing strategic operations and organizational growth.
Directed regional-scale esports tournaments, managing logistics, venue operations, and participant recruitment.
Initiated discussions with external esports organizations to develop the competitive gaming ecosystem in Indonesia.
